# Charitable Giving Optimizer Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills > Industry > Wealth Management

## Overview

Use when optimizing charitable giving strategies for high-net-worth clients including donor-advised funds, charitable trusts, private foundations, and qualified charitable distributions for tax-efficient philanthropy.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [charitable-giving-optimizer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
charitable-giving-optimizer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@charitable-giving-optimizer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Compare charitable vehicles: DAF, CRT, CLT, private foundation, direct gift
- Calculate charitable deduction under AGI limitations by contribution type
- Model Charitable Remainder Trust income streams and remainder interest
- Design bunching strategies with donor-advised funds for itemization optimization

## Industry Standards Applied

- **IRC Section 170**: Charitable contribution deduction rules and AGI limitations
- **IRC Section 664**: Charitable remainder trust requirements and taxation
- **IRC Section 4940-4945**: Private foundation excise taxes and distribution requirements
